note: The index over this repository's AGENTS.md: each rule quotes its guide's line and is read by it; accepted with the author's OK.

rules.text: a behavior change or a fix comes with a test
quote: A behavior change or a fix comes with a test that fails on the old code and passes after.

rules.text: ruff and pytest ran on the final tree
quote: Checks: `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pytest`, which needs 80% coverage.

rules.text: local only, from pinned revisions that results name
quote: Local only: no request content goes to a hosted API. Models load from pinned revisions, and each model's results name its revision.

rules.text: an input past a model's window is never cut silently
quote: An input past a model's window is refused or reported with an explicit status, never cut without saying so; `/embed/texts` truncates, as documented.

rules.text: a server fault is an opaque 500
quote: A server fault is logged and answered with an opaque 500, never as a client error.
One worker: rate limits and admission live in one process.
Dependencies are pinned to exact versions in `requirements.txt`.
Prefer focused fixes over new endpoints, frameworks or dependencies.
`/corpus/gpt` and `/judge` admit one request running and two waiting, then answer 503 with `Retry-After`. The body is validated before admission, and a slot is given back on every outcome.
`/judge` schemas are bounded before llama.cpp sees a grammar; schemas that crashed it stay covered by tests run in a child process.

rules.text: a caller's text is tokenized as text
quote: A caller's text and a model's thought are tokenized as text: a chat-template mark in them is never a control token.

rules.text: the AMR decoder joins only what the parser split
quote: The AMR decoder joins only what the parser split, and supplies no concept, relation or target; `linearized_raw` keeps the model's output as generated.

rules.text: callers stay out of the repository
quote: No caller's name, text or purpose in docs, code, tests or commit messages; tests use made-up inputs. Docs describe eGemma's own contract.
